bioParagraphs: I am Sreeraj, a freelance 3D artist and character animator who uses Blender as my primary digital atelier. For over 6 years, I have shaped raw digital vertices into expressive, memorable characters with distinct personalities and weight.

My creative philosophy bridges classical figurative sculpting with cutting-edge real-time 3D pipelines. Whether designing stylized game protagonists, biomechanical creatures, or cinematic props, I engineer every model with production-clean quad topology, custom deformation rigging, and physically accurate lighting.
When I am not in the Blender 3D viewport sculpting or keyframing walk cycles, I experiment with custom procedural shader nodes, groom simulations, and real-time lighting in Unreal Engine.

process.name: Concept & Silhouette
process.shortDesc: Visual narrative, anatomical thumbnailing, and proportion studies.
process.details: Every character starts with strong 2D shape language. I test multiple dynamic silhouettes to ensure instant readability before entering 3D space.

process.name: Sculpt & Topology
process.shortDesc: High-poly digital clay sculpted into clean, deformable quad topology.
process.details: Using dynamic topology sculpting in Blender and ZBrush, I carve primary anatomical volumes and micro-skin wrinkles. I then retopologize with edge loops optimized for facial distortion and joint bends.

process.name: Rigging & Deformation
process.shortDesc: Bespoke bone armature, inverse kinematics, and facial blendshapes.
process.details: A model without a rig is just a statue. I build articulated skeletons with IK/FK switching, corrective shape keys for elbows/shoulders, and 52 standard Apple ARKit blendshapes for facial animation.

process.name: Animation & Physics
process.shortDesc: Keyframing emotion, secondary cloth dynamics, and weight distribution.
process.details: Bringing life into the rig through nuanced timing, squash-and-stretch, anticipation, and secondary physical motion such as hair strand drag and cloth drapery.

process.name: Lighting & Shading
process.shortDesc: 3-point cinematic rim lighting, subsurface scattering, and final render.
process.details: The signature ember look: careful placement of key lights, soft atmospheric fill, and molten rim lights to accentuate character contours and material roughness in Cycles X.
